Astra to me is a bit of the holy grail.  The ability for AI to see my screen and understand the ENTIRE WORLD OF SOFTWARE or WEB SITES and GUIDE ME to do ANYTHING AT ALL that I ask it for is absolutely when I get out my wallet and fork over $20/month.

As a musician with a home recording studio, I run literally hundreds of software packages, and having an expert (based upon the PDF manual, YouTube "tip" videos, Reddit posts, etc.) that can answer any question and guide me in its use is INVALUABLE.  I also love trying out and finding new software so would also use it for everything else on my computer.

TARS-UI and the like WILL be great when they turn this into "just do it" for the AI, but for now, I'd be ecstatic to just have a ready WORLD CLASS EXPERT on anything my computer could EVER do already.
